newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - NatPower names Australia debt underwriters.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - NatPower names Australia debt underwriters.

text.p: National Power Plc said on Tuesday it had appointed UBS Australia Ltd lead arranger for the underwriting and eventual syndication of the debt used to finance the purchase of Hazelwood power station from the state government of Victoria.
UBS also would be agent bank and security trustee and , supported by Societe Generale Australia, would handle documentation up to financial close, National Power said in a statement.
Citibank will take responsibility for syndication.
A spokesman for National Power declined to comment on what proportion of the power station's A$2.35 billion purchase price would be funded by debt or other details of the project finance.
Commonwealth Bank of Australia (CBA) will be the account holding bank and oversee engineering and insurance.
National Power holds a 52 percent stake in the consortium which successfully bid for Hazelwood earlier this month.
Other consortium members comprise Destec Energy Inc with 20 percent, PacificCorp with 19.9 percent, Commonwealth Financial Services with 6.1 percent and CBA with two percent.
The National Power spokesman said financial close was expected to occur early next month.
